name: A Reproducible Simulation Benchmark of a Two-Stage UAV Free-Space Optical Terminal for Aerial IoT Backhaul
description: Simulation code, configurations, tests, per-run records and generated tables behind the article "A Reproducible Simulation Benchmark of a Two-Stage UAV Free-Space Optical Terminal for Aerial IoT Backhaul: Control Laws, State Estimators, and the Interaction with the Flight Controller" (N. Daoud and M. Eltahan, submitted to IoT, MDPI). The archive holds the terminal simulator and the fixed-wing and quadrotor flight models, the two plant configurations with the origin of every parameter, the benchmark drivers, the test suite, and one record per run of the control-law, estimator and flight studies. Every table and number in the article is generated by scripts in this archive and re-verified from the raw records by scripts/verify_papers.py. The manuscript itself is not part of the deposit.
